# RM brief — ECI 9 GP LIMITED (SC349083)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by SEC-07 — Negative pledge  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- ECI 9 GP LIMITED (company number SC349083) is an active private limited company incorporated on 25 September 2008, filing small-company accounts under SIC code 64999. `[profile]`
- The board is small, with 2 active officers out of 9 ever appointed, and one director appointed on 13 October 2025. `[officers]`
- The company has two registered charges, both in favour of Silicon Valley Bank and both recorded as fully satisfied: one created on 31 March 2015 (fixed and floating) and one created on 20 May 2015 (floating). `[SC3490830001; SC3490830002]`
- Because every registered charge is fully satisfied, the security position is treated as clean and satisfied charges are disregarded for ranking, so a first-charge facility is not blocked on ranking grounds. `[SEC-02; SEC-03; SC3490830001; SC3490830002]`
- However, both charges were registered with a negative pledge, which is why the case is referred: written consent from the existing lender must be evidenced before any facility is offered, notwithstanding the satisfied status. `[SEC-07; SC3490830001; SC3490830002]`
- Filing conduct is strong: the most recent accounts to 31 December 2025 were filed on 8 May 2026, some 143 days early, nothing is overdue and the next accounts are not due until 30 September 2027. `[AA filed 2026-05-08; profile; computed]`
- The only blemishes in the accounts history are minor — filings 3 days late in 2016 and 21 days late in 2021 — with every other year filed ahead of deadline. `[AA filed 2016-10-01; AA filed 2021-10-19; AA filed 2025-04-29; AA filed 2024-08-12]`
